questions.question: Determine the ratio of the number of students who play Football to the number of students who play Basketball in a survey of 120 students from the following table: Play Football and Basketball: 25 Play Football but not Basketball: 45 Play Basketball but not Football: 35 Play neither sport: 15
questions.questionHtml:
Determine the ratio of the number of students who play Football to the number of students who play Basketball in a survey of 120 students from the following table:

Play Football and Basketball: 25

Play Football but not Basketball: 45

Play Basketball but not Football: 35

Play neither sport: 15
questions.solution:
• Calculate totals:

• Total Football players = Football only + Football and Basketball = 45 + 25 = 70

• Total Basketball players = Basketball only + Football and Basketball = 35 + 25 = 60

• Ratio Football : Basketball = 70 : 60 = 7 : 6

• Verification: 70 + 60 - 25 + 15 = 120 ✓

• Answer: 7:6

questions.question: A batsman's average score for a certain number of innings is 44. If he scores 132 runs in the next innings, his average becomes 48. How many innings did he play earlier?
questions.questionHtml: A batsman's average score for a certain number of innings is 44. If he scores 132 runs in the next innings, his average becomes 48. How many innings did he play earlier?
questions.solution:
• Let number of earlier innings = n

• Total runs earlier = 44n

• After new innings: (44n + 132)/(n+1) = 48

• 44n + 132 = 48n + 48

• 132 - 48 = 48n - 44n

• 84 = 4n

• n = 21

• Answer: 21

questions.question: A tea seller bought 15 kg of Darjeeling tea at Rs.300 per kg and 25 kg of Assam tea at Rs.240 per kg. He mixed them together. Due to a slight drop in market prices, he had to sell the entire mixture at Rs.260 per kg. Calculate his total profit or loss.
questions.questionHtml: A tea seller bought 15 kg of Darjeeling tea at Rs.300 per kg and 25 kg of Assam tea at Rs.240 per kg. He mixed them together. Due to a slight drop in market prices, he had to sell the entire mixture at Rs.260 per kg. Calculate his total profit or loss.
questions.solution:
• Calculate cost and revenue:

• Cost = 15 × 300 + 25 × 240 = 4500 + 6000 = Rs.10,500

• Total weight = 15 + 25 = 40 kg

• Revenue = 40 × 260 = Rs.10,400

• Result = 10,400 - 10,500 = -Rs.100 → Loss of Rs.100

• Answer: Loss of Rs.100

questions.question: What is the equation of line through (0,3) with slope -1?
questions.questionHtml: What is the equation of line through (0,3) with slope -1?
questions.solution:
• Using slope-intercept form: y = mx + c

• m = -1 (slope), c = y-intercept

• Point (0,3) is the y-intercept, so c = 3

• Equation: y = -x + 3

• Answer: y = -x + 3
